measured: LibreChat (f10b1d91), Twenty (1d561b8c) and Dub, Cal.diy and Rallly at the demand scan's commits were read on 2026-11-09 for OpenTelemetry exporters, OTLP endpoints and HyperDX. LibreChat's browser RUM names HyperDX as its one provider (RUM_PROVIDER defaults to hyperdx) and LibreChat and Twenty export OTLP to the endpoint an operator sets; all of it only when an operator turns it on (optional, below). Dub, Cal.diy and Rallly export none. The exporters were read at the versions the applications' lockfiles resolve: LibreChat's NodeSDK 0.218.0 takes OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL (http/protobuf by default) and sends binary protobuf with @opentelemetry/exporter-trace-otlp-proto and exporter-logs-otlp-proto 0.218.0; Twenty's @opentelemetry/exporter-metrics-otlp-http 0.219.0 sends JSON; @hyperdx/browser 0.24.0 sends its spans to <url>/v1/traces and its session replay to <url>/v1/logs. OTLP/gRPC (LibreChat's OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=grpc) is another transport and is not served. No application reads HyperDX's External API; the bench does, as an engineer reads an incident (platform, below).

optional.what: the server's traces and logs through the OpenTelemetry NodeSDK (HTTP, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose and undici instrumentations; Winston logs through the OpenTelemetry transport) to OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
optional.setting: Configuration: OTEL_TRACING_ENABLED and OTEL_LOGS_ENABLED, both false by default (.env.example:337,340; packages/api/src/telemetry/config.ts:36-37).

optional.what: the browser's real-user monitoring through HyperDX's browser SDK (RUM_PROVIDER, whose default and only supported value is hyperdx), sending its spans and session replay as OTLP to RUM_URL with RUM_PUBLIC_TOKEN
optional.setting: Configuration: RUM_ENABLED, false by default (.env.example:365; api/server/services/Config/rum.js:72); with it on, the provider is HyperDX unless another is named (rum.js:76).

frontend.call: HyperDX.init with the configured url: browser spans exported to <url>/v1/traces
HyperDX.init's session replay (rrweb events) exported as log records to <url>/v1/logs

optional.what: the server's metrics through a periodic OTLP metric exporter to OTLP_COLLECTOR_METRICS_ENDPOINT_URL
optional.setting: Configuration: METER_DRIVER including opentelemetry, empty by default (packages/twenty-server/.env.example:46; packages/twenty-server/src/engine/core-modules/twenty-config/config-variables.ts:1248).

platform.what: The bench runs the reference applications with their telemetry on; LibreChat's and Twenty's OpenTelemetry exporters, LibreChat's HyperDX browser RUM and any OpenTelemetry SDK reach the World's HyperDX ingest, whose spans, log records and metric points the bench's evidence adapter reads.

A task's World holds the incident in its telemetry twins, read through those vendors' own APIs as a developer reads them: an engineer finds HyperDX's sources and searches its logs and traces (a trace by its TraceId, a service's slow spans, the error logs) through the External API with a personal API key.
